title: Fix Firebase App Hosting rollout by disabling default Next export output
body: ## Summary - stop forcing `output: 'export'` in `next.config.js` - keep static export available via explicit opt-in: `NEXT_OUTPUT_EXPORT=1` - add comments clarifying App Hosting requires server build artifacts (`.next/standalone`) ## Root Cause Firebase App Hosting's Next.js adapter expects standalone server artifacts. With `output: 'export'` always enabled, the adapter failed looking for `.next/standalone/.next/routes-manifest.json`, causing rollout build failure. ## Validation - `npm run build` - `npx --yes apphosting-local-build --framework nextjs /workspace`
